video_title: Kawhi Leonard signs extension with Raptors 👀 Shams breaks down the deal | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard signs two-year extension with Toronto Raptors
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi Leonard has reached agreement on a two-year, $115 million contract extension with the Toronto Raptors.
quotes.quote: Kawhi Leonard has reached agreement on a two-year, $115 million contract extension with the Toronto Raptors. This reunion will now extend long-term. This gives him three years and $165 million total on his Raptors deal. He also does have a player option in 2028, but my understanding is that he fully expects to retire and finish his career in Toronto, and this deal allows him to do that.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins calls Kawhi Leonard the summer's biggest winner
quotes.excerpt: Kawhi was the unquestioned winner of the summer and with two days into the fall, he's in the lead.
quotes.quote: Kawhi was the unquestioned winner of the summer and with two days into the fall, he's in the lead. Regardless of what you think of him or anybody thinks of the way he operated during the Clippers tenure, on the court last year, he was awesome. He drove an incredible value for the Clippers in trade because of that season. Getting him in Toronto with the rest of the guys they've got in that core, specifically Scottie Barnes who had a tremendous breakout year, there is reason for the Raptors to totally celebrate having him locked into a short-term contract extension.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kawhi Leonard's impact on Raptors team dynamics and defensive identity
quotes.excerpt: I think that when you add Kawhi Leonard, one, you bring the defensive prowess up.
quotes.quote: They needed that push to jump in Toronto. They had the moments where it was like, what team are we watching? Are they the scary team or is Atlanta the scary team? They had those moments and I think that when you add Kawhi Leonard, one, you bring the defensive prowess up, but I think that you change the tilt. A lot of the tilt that happened that kind of screwed them up when they had BI operating in those spots, he was just a little young, wasn't having as good of a shooting night. I think Kawhi fixes a lot of that for them and if they were already scary with Scottie Barnes in the league, they are going to be jumping.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson questions the risk of Kawhi Leonard's contract extension
quotes.excerpt: 115 million dollars for a player with those durability issues in his mid-30s, that is a massive contract.
quotes.quote: Getting Kawhi Leonard raises the ceiling to championship possibilities for Toronto. Let's not act like this is not a massive risk. This is a guy who has played 60 plus games three times in the last nine years. Now, one of those, 60 on the nose, was in Toronto and they led him to a title, but 115 million dollars for a player with those durability issues in his mid-30s, that is a massive contract. That's not a discount deal. A discount deal is Kevin Durant, two-year 90 million dollar extension. This is 25 million more than that.

quotes.speaker: Malika Andrews
quotes.summary_phrase: Debating which teams can win an Eastern Conference playoff series
quotes.excerpt: Cavaliers, Knicks, Heat, 76ers, Pistons, and you can put the Raptors in there, maybe the Pacers.

text_blocks.speaker: Malika Andrews
text_blocks.text: Let's take this off. Cavaliers, Knicks, Heat, 76ers, Pistons, and you can put the Raptors in there, maybe the Pacers, one of those guys going to win a playoff series. At least one is not, yep, is not going to win a playoff series. Like that's what we're talking about in the Eastern Conference.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: I was going to say, you better put the Pacers in there.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Did you say the Heat? The Heat is not going to win a playoff series.
